title: Fold lines
text:
Fold lines. It came folded in the box, and i left it out 24 hr but the lines were still prevelant.

You probably shouldn't fold memory foam.

Maybe more time would've solved the issue, but i don't have the time to experiment, so i returned it.

product_metadata.title: MAYSHINE Memory Foam Non Slip Anti Fatigue Bath Mat | Thick Absorbent Plush Velvet Bathroom Rug - Machine Washable, 58x24, Chocolate Brown
features: DESIGN √ Special technical process combined with memory foam and soft fluffs, in order to strengthen the water absorption. It has three-dimensional utility beddinig fabric that conforms to your body while maintaining air circulation.

CONVENIENCE √ This kind of mat has a light weight. It is convenient to use. When you want to change its place, can kick to move it. It is suitable for bathroom, vacation home, guest suite or some you want to have a memory foam bath mat.

COMFORT √ Filled with soft 49D memory foam, which has a comfortable thickness. And outer material is super tiny and cozy fluffs. Stepping onto it, you will have a relaxing feeling. It can relieve feet pressure before and after bathing.

NON SLIP √ The bottom is made of high quality gray PVC material, not easy to become yellow. You will not slip or slide, when you step on it. It brings superior safety in your bathroom. Before use, please dry the floor intended for mat placement.

MACHINE WASH √ Easy to clean, machine or hand wash is fine. It can fast drying and never has a problem with smell at all. Just wash it in up to 40℃ water with tide liquid on the gentle cycle. Lay or hang to air dry.
